purpose: Probe whether a shallow Qwen3-8B prefix exposes a stable direction for completed autobiographical events, distinct from plans, recommendations, negations, and general discussion.

concepts.name: autobiographical_completed_event
concepts.description: The speaker states that they personally completed or experienced a concrete event, rather than planning, denying, recommending, or discussing it abstractly.
